summary:
Research of w126 (requests r1-r5) done; notes at .shop/scratch/1-research/notes.md.
No request scenario is bound or runnable today: no test_requests.py, no steps, and scripts/work has no request/outcome/turn/resolve.
Accepted scenarios r4 and r5 need work outcome (r15) and work turn (r7), which this work-item does not accept.
r2 can reuse model_parse.ears (probed: all five faults flagged, good lines pass) without clingo.
Defect D1: model check reports 'file: .shop/work/requests: no initiative.md' for any requests dir (run).
Defect D2: --work-item with unbound scenarios aborts collection with INTERNALERROR (run).
No map: tools tests-of unavailable, so test lists are by search.
File set: scripts/work (edit), new scripts/workqueue_request.py, new tests/scenarios/test_requests.py and requests_steps.py; reused, unchanged: workqueue.py, model_parse.py.
6 open questions (acceptance of r7/r15, r12 commit, upstream root, lines.md form, r2 check route, D1 scope).
questions: r4 and r5 scenarios use work outcome (r15) and work turn (r7), neither accepted by w126: accept them or leave those scenarios red?
r12 (commit) is not accepted but the existing write path commits via workqueue.committed: should work request commit?
work request names no upstream root in the scenarios; which root does it write to (the capability says the upstream's .shop/work/requests/ through the upstream's work)?
Form of lines.md is not given by the capability or the scenarios: one line each, or bullets with [r<n>]?
r2 strict check: model_parse.ears (no clingo) or model.lp v_e1/v_e2 via clingo (needing_clingo)?
D1 (model check flags the requests dir) and the 13 red design-model-check request scenarios belong to design-model-check: in or out of w126?
